sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Top Shooter are simple yet engaging. Players use their mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to aim and shoot at the oncoming zombies. The game features a variety of guns, each with its unique characteristics, such as firing speed, damage, and accuracy. As you progress through the game, you'll unlock new guns, allowing you to experiment with different playstyles and tactics.


One of the most critical aspects of Top Shooter is the movement mechanics. Players can move left or right, allowing them to position themselves for optimal shooting. The game also features a dash mechanic, which enables players to quickly move across the screen and avoid incoming zombies. This mechanic is essential for surviving extended periods and achieving high scores.


Scoring is a crucial aspect of Top Shooter. Players earn points for each zombie they kill, with bonus points awarded for consecutive kills and achieving certain milestones. The game also features leaderboards, where players can compete with each other to achieve the highest scores. This competitive element adds a layer of depth to the game, making it more engaging and challenging.
